name: Clear
description: A clear sky; the day's heat is the season's own.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); mechanics.md row 35 (immersion: the world gets on without you)

name: Hot
description: A hard, white heat from mid-morning; men drink twice as often and rest at noon.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); wb §4.1 (the drought that is breaking the world); schedules.csv midday_rest

name: Scorching
description: The drought's own weather: air that shakes over the fields, water skins emptied before noon, nothing moving on the roads.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); wb §4.1 (the drought); regions.csv south (only death reigns here)

name: Sandstorm
description: A wall of dust off the southern desert; the sun goes brown, tracks vanish and no one raids or rides until it passes.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); regions.csv south (endless desert; a vast open desert with no water); notes L136-143

name: Rain
description: Rain from the sea: the tracks turn to mud, the canals run and the city breathes.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); seasons.csv rains

name: River fog
description: A dawn fog off the river and the marsh that hides a man at twenty paces — the raiders' friend.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); regions.csv west plan 1 (swamps and wetlands)
